name: Wordmark Footer
description: A chartreuse studio footer with link columns, a newsletter form, a live local clock and a giant wordmark fitted edge to edge and cut at the floor.

props.name: wordmark
props.description: The giant word. Measured on the client and fitted to the container width exactly. Words without descenders read best.

props.name: headline
props.default: "Got a brief, a hunch or a half-built thing?"
props.description: Closing line above the email link.

props.name: email
props.description: Large mailto link with an arrow chip.

props.name: columns
props.type: { title: string; links: { label; href; note?; external? }[] }[]
props.description: Link columns. note renders as a small black tag ("2 open"); external adds ↗ and opens a new tab.

props.name: address
props.description: Address lines in the Visit column.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: IANA time zone for the clock, which ticks every second.

props.name: newsletter
props.type: { title; body; placeholder; button; success: string }
props.description: Copy for the newsletter block and its success state.

props.name: onSubscribe
props.description: Called with a valid address on submit.

props.name: legal
props.description: Company line in the legal bar.

props.name: clip
props.description: How much of the wordmark's cap height the bottom edge cuts off (0–0.3).
